author: /root/nestedreference159_groundwork
scope: Read-only source audit. No browser executions, product edits, backend writes or whole-item acceptance. Findings are risks, not runtime-confirmed defects.

findings.chain: Units > normalized import > unresolved row Create unit > accepted registry POST > close registry > discard import without Apply
findings.observation: Nested registry gets three arguments, omitting the optional accepted-mutation lifecycle. Its legacy callback refreshes only importer corrections/options. The importer parent is notified only by an accepted Apply. No parent freshness follows a unit creation alone.
findings.expected: After final importer close, refresh the still-owned Unit board and complete fallback reference list while retaining existing fallback order, settings drafts, search, campus and month. No import Apply or fallback PUT should occur.

findings.chain: Units > Add posting > Add unit > accepted registry POST > close registry > discard posting editor
findings.observation: Nested registry only pushes returned unit into editor choices and draft; cancelling posting editor never invokes main saved callback. Unit existence is already persisted and independent of unsaved posting.
findings.expected: Final editor close must refresh current parent for the accepted unit mutation only. Preserve unrelated parent settings/order/filter drafts and never save the discarded posting.

findings.chain: Importer or record editor > Manage labels and mappings > accepted catalog PUT > its GET fails > close catalog > close unsaved owner
findings.observation: Catalog saved callback fires only after its readback succeeds. On accepted PUT plus readback503, closing has no mutation lifecycle notification; even successful callbacks reach only dirtyPreview/options/cache invalidation.
findings.expected: Notify actual accepted reference mutation before its GET; final enclosing close should refresh only relevant dependent data. Map actual consumers before choosing endpoints. Do not claim all current labels come from catalog: main also has static call/leave label helpers.

findings.chain: Importer or record editor > Create member > accepted admin member POST > discard owner without Apply/posting save
findings.observation: Accepted create calls done(member) for local choices only. This same done callback also handles Use existing member at lines148-157, so it cannot be treated unconditionally as a mutation. Nested Review/restore at lines165-176 similarly only checks candidates on change.
findings.expected: Distinct confirmed-mutation notification, excluding read-only Use existing and cancelled/failed creates. Determine actual Unit member picker consumer; member creation alone need not change posting counts or generate assignments.
